reviews.title: Excellent Firsthand Knowledge
reviews.review: This podcast is very good. Ms. Sutton tells her experience with depression and anxiety and feeling hopeless. She describes seasons when she was able and unable to ask for and receive help.

reviews.title: She Persisted
reviews.review: I love this podcast SO much! I have a hard time feeling loved by everyone around me but this podcast really helps me! I also know that God can help me too! I love this podcast and love your story and journey! Thank you so much, Sadie!♥️

reviews.title: Very helpful
reviews.review: I am currently recovering from a week long stay in a mental health facility after experiencing sleep deprivation brought on by PTSD and this really helped to hear… I keep struggling with not understanding why I still feel so scared and uncomfortable but doing this practice will make me clearly see my brain and body are recovering from serious trauma … the more I force  “feeling better” the harder this will be … I need to keep track of when I feel those moments of relief… even if they only last a short while♥️

reviews.title: Reaching those in need
reviews.review: As a mother of teens/ young adults, I appreciate how Sadie provides meaningful guidance that is relatable for all ages. She and her guests have a wealth of personal, practical and professional insight that makes each episode a unique learning experience. I've recommended this podcast to many friends, and continue to believe that the open discussion of mental health issues that this show fosters will help to reach those hearts in need.

If you are struggling in ANY way, I cannot recommend this podcast enough. I can’t wait to listen to more! Thank you so much for creating such a safe space for mental health and healing.

Thank you so much for the most awesome podcast!!!!

reviews.title: Great mental health podcast!

reviews.title: Super informative and very well produced
reviews.review: My go-to podcast when I’m looking to learn. Guests are consistently articulate and bring expertise to diversity of topics within the realms of mental and physical health. Sadie is a sharp interviewer and always has thoughtful but brief commentary to add after the guest has a chance to respond. Additionally, love the solo episodes and Sadie’s lessons on DBT. She is incredibly savvy in the world of mental health and is actually studying to become a practitioner - though I’m sure this podcast is broadening her education as well, which is really cool. Total gem of a podcast, I recommend it all the time.

reviews.title: Sadie’s podcast is SO needed!
reviews.review: Sadie is AMAZING! Absolutely love her podcast and her mission to share experiences and support others! I had the opportunity to be a part of her podcast and it was such an honor. Keep up the amazing work, girl!

reviews.title: Inspiring & Educational
reviews.review: I admire Sadie and all that she is doing when it comes to advocating for mental health, specifically teen mental health. Sadie is personable, knowledgeable and fun to listen to! reviews.title: Teen Mental Health Superstar!!💕✨
reviews.review:
So so proud of all you’ve accomplished, Sadie! There’s SO many episodes that there’s  guaranteed to be a few that resonate, whether you’re a parent or teen learning to best support your mental health or you want to hear about others’ experiences and how to better your mindset. Sadie’s done an excellent job pouring her heart and soul into her beautiful brand and podcast and I can’t wait to see what she’ll accomplish next!
—Hailey, The Sunshine Signal Podcast
